Welcome, Mr. Ferraro. Here's your badge and program. You're speaking in the afternoon session, right?

There's a speakers' room on the second floor with a projector. It's open all day.

audio.t: Next month, the finance team is moving to the fourth floor, so we'll have more space here.
Could we turn their old area into a quiet room? It's hard to concentrate with the open layout.
I like that idea. We could also add a couple of phone booths for private calls.
Let's put both ideas in a proposal. Felix, could you get a quote for the phone booths?

questions.evidence: the finance team is moving to the fourth floor
questions.explanation: L'équipe financière déménage au quatrième étage.

options: It is difficult to focus in the office.
questions.evidence: It's hard to concentrate with the open layout.

audio.t: I need to send these product samples to our client in Madrid. The meeting there is in four days.
Then the package should arrive no later than the day before, to be safe.
Right. And I'd like to be able to track it, since the samples are fragile.
Then choose the cheapest option that meets both conditions.

questions.prompt: What is the man sending?
questions.evidence: I need to send these product samples
questions.explanation: Il envoie des échantillons de produits au client.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which service will the man most likely choose?
questions.explanation: Le colis doit arriver au plus tard la veille (donc en 3 jours maximum) avec suivi : Standard (3–4 jours) n'est pas garanti, Express (2 jours, suivi) est le moins cher qui convient.
questions.traps: Standard pourrait prendre 4 jours, trop tard ; Overnight convient mais coûte plus cher.
questions.takeaway: Avec une fourchette (3–4 jours), considère le pire cas.

questions.prompt: Why does the man want tracking?
questions.evidence: since the samples are fragile
questions.explanation: Il veut un suivi du colis parce que les échantillons sont fragiles.

audio.t: Jonas, the invoice we sent to Marlow Construction in March still hasn't been paid. It's now sixty days overdue.
That's unusual for them. They've always paid on time.
I know. I sent two reminders, but nobody answered.
Their accountant left the company last month. Let me call their operations manager directly; I know her well.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.evidence: still hasn't been paid
questions.explanation: Une facture envoyée à un client n'est toujours pas réglée.

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, "Their accountant left the company last month"?

To explain why the invoice was wrong
questions.evidence: Their accountant left the company last month.
questions.explanation: Le départ du comptable explique probablement l'absence de réponse aux relances.

questions.prompt: What will the man do?
options: Call a manager at the client company
questions.evidence: Let me call their operations manager directly
questions.explanation: Il appellera directement la responsable des opérations, qu'il connaît bien.

audio.t: Hi, I'd like to order lunch for twenty people for a meeting on Thursday.

audio.t: I'm signing up for a Spanish course this autumn. My level is already intermediate, so I'd skip the beginner levels.
